Subject: Westrow Hotel Group - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Westrow Hotel Group submission. I've reviewed the materials and everything we need is included—appreciate the complete package!

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team for the following reasons:

- Hotel class requires management review
- Three locations within 16 km of the coast
- Our existing coastal portfolio concentration in this area is already high

Before I escalate this, can you help me with a few questions?

- What specific wind mitigation features are in place at each property?
- Are any of the locations elevated, and if so, to what height?
- Would the insured consider higher wind/hail deductibles to improve terms?

I'd recommend also reaching out to a coastal specialty market that focuses on hospitality risks in these areas.

Let me know on those questions and I'll push this up the chain.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
